nodes.name: Emergency Management Software for Schools - Raptor Alert
Prepare, Respond, and Recover in One Platform
Equip staff to act decisively with instant alerts, live visibility into who’s safe, and step-by-step reunification that helps keep everyone calm and informed.
Real-Time Communication When It Matters Most
In this testimonial, Principal Annitra Leigh describes how Raptor Alert helped her navigate a real lockdown when a student arrived on campus with a firearm.
Raptor’s emergency management platform helped keep information flowing between staff, administrators, and district leadership in real time.
Hear how preparation, clear workflows, and Raptor Alert’s instant communication supported confident leadership during a high-stakes event.
Staff use one app for everyday issues and real emergencies. Team Assist sends the right alert to the right team in seconds, whether it's a medical, behavioral, or facilities issue.
Staff call or text 911 directly from the platform. Dispatchers automatically receive the caller's name, location, and incident type, so responders know where to go before they arrive.

Match each student to an approved guardian with photo verification, electronic signatures, and timestamps, so every release is documented.
Generate detailed reports on drills, alerts, accountability, and reunification events to identify gaps, strengthen protocols, and support after-action reviews.
Raptor Connect links your existing PA, door locks, sirens, mass notification, and classroom displays, so one alert activates them all.
